▎ Task: eliminate per-tick disk-write noise at the source — the class, not the instance. One new issue (reference #1275 and #1179), one PR.
▎
▎ Context: Live measurement (2026-07-10, box, mostly-idle session): the decision-evidence file grew 760MB in 24 minutes (~100 records/sec, multi-KB each). Restart recovery reads only the last recovery_evidence_max_bytes (1MiB) of that file, fail-closed — so a noise-flooded file blinds crash recovery regardless of disk size. This fix is a prerequisite for the 24h soak's kill/restart acceptance leg.
▎
▎ The class boundary (MECE requirement): the unit of enumeration is NOT the one flooding record kind — it is every disk-append path reachable from a per-tick handler (quote, book, timer, index-price) in the strategy and live-node modules. Produce a table in the PR body listing EVERY such path — every decision-evidence record kind (the full enum in bolt_v3_decision_evidence.rs) plus any non-evidence per-tick appender you find — and place each in exactly one bucket:
▎ 1. EVENT-KEYED, stays per-event: kinds that recovery, reconciliation, or settlement read, or that record a real action (order intents, lifecycle transitions, settlement + booking-error records, reservations). Completeness untouchable.
▎ 2. STATE-OBSERVATION, gets state-change keying: repeats of identical state carry zero information for every named reader → dedupe on a state key (patterns: #885 exit-outcome key; EntrySkipDedupeKey; #1351 log keying).
▎ 3. ALREADY-DEDUPED, verify not vacuous: for each existing dedupe (entry-skip, exit-outcome), confirm the key contains NO per-tick-varying field (a price or timestamp in the key = dedupe that never fires). Fix any you find.
▎ 4. NO NAMED READER: if a kind has no consumer at all, do not silently drop it — flag it in the table with your evidence for the owner's decision.
▎ The classification criterion, applied per kind: "who reads this record, and does an identical repeat carry information for that reader?" Every path in exactly one bucket; no path unlisted.
▎
▎ Required tests: per bucket-2 kind, a differential — N identical evaluations produce exactly 1 record, a state change produces the 2nd — that FAILS on current code. Per bucket-3 fix, same shape. State in the PR body that in-memory dedupe keys reset on restart (one duplicate per key per process lifetime — accepted, same ruling as #1351's terminal evidence).
▎
▎ Constraints: do not touch the capture module, rotation, journald, or any uploader (deferred post-soak, out of scope). Do not change any record's schema — only whether an identical repeat is written.
▎
▎ Gates: full unfiltered suite at head (no scope filters), fmt, literal audit if strings change. Report: head SHA + the bucket table. The reviewer will cross-check your table against the box's actual record histogram at deploy time — the table must predict what the box shows.
